tracks.title: Clearance Rack Two-Step
tracks.subject: a man who buys cowboy boots off the clearance rack for a Saturday dance and can't peel the bright orange $39.99 sticker off the sole, so every spin on the floor shows the whole room what he paid
tracks.caption: Neotraditional honky-tonk, 90s-style dancehall country. Twangy Telecaster chicken-pickin' fills, crying pedal steel swells, double-stop fiddle answering each line, walking upright bass, brushed shuffle drums with a snappy snare. Dry live-band mix with slapback echo on the vocal. Male baritone with a warm Texas drawl, deadpan and winking. 118 BPM, G major. Rowdy, sly and grinning. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no arena rock guitars, no pop synths, no hip-hop beat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Telecaster and fiddle]

[Verse 1]
Found 'em on the bottom shelf
Ostrich brown and almost new
Thirty-nine and ninety-nine
Bright orange on the left shoe

[Chorus]
Every time I spin her round
That sticker winks at the crowd
Clearance rack two-step
I'm cheap and I'm proud

[Verse 2]
Tried my thumbnail, tried a key
Tried a little gasoline
Now the whole floor knows my price
Every turn they read it clean

[Chorus]
Every time I dip her low
Back row starts to read out loud
Clearance rack two-step
I'm cheap and I'm proud

[Bridge - fiddle break]
She just laughed and leaned in close
Said her dress was half price too

[Chorus]
So spin me, darlin', spin me round
Show 'em both our tags right now
Clearance rack two-step
We're cheap and we're proud

[Outro - pedal steel tag]
Thirty-nine and ninety-nine
Best money I spent all year

tracks.title: Bless You, Forty-One
tracks.subject: a woman in hay-fever season who secretly keeps count of how many times her boyfriend says bless you, and realises on the forty-first sneeze of April that he has never once missed one
tracks.caption: Orchestral jazz-pop in a vintage crooner style. Close-miked string quartet playing lush legato chords, nylon-string guitar with soft bossa-leaning comping, walking upright bass, twinkling celesta on the turnarounds, light brushed drums. Warm vintage room sound with soft tape hiss. Female alto, low and velvety, conversational with a smile in it. 84 BPM, Bb major. Tender, wry and lovestruck. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM, no belted pop runs, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - strings and celesta]

[Verse 1]
The birch trees out on Elm Street
Have it in for me again
I sneeze into my sleeve
You say bless you from the den

[Pre-Chorus]
I started keeping score
On the back of my hand

[Chorus]
Bless you, thirty-nine
Bless you, forty too
Every single time
It comes from you

[Verse 2]
You say it with your mouth full
You say it half asleep
You said it through the shower door
Without missing a beat

[Pre-Chorus]
I wasn't counting love
I was counting tissues

[Chorus]
Bless you, forty-one
Muffled through the wall
I think I've been blessed
More than I recall

[Bridge - strings swell]
Let the pollen fall all May
I'll let you keep the count

[Outro - nylon guitar alone]
Achoo
Bless you, love

tracks.title: Cone Of Shame
tracks.subject: a man whose beagle comes home from the vet wearing a plastic cone after a minor operation and spends the week bumping into doorframes, the coffee table and the cat
tracks.caption: 90s Eurodance revival. Detuned supersaw synth stabs on the offbeats, rolling octave-jumping bassline, four-on-the-floor 909 kick with open hi-hats, a classic rave piano riff in the choruses. Big glossy club mix with wide synths and a punchy compressed kick. Female lead with a bright powerful mezzo on the choruses, male deadpan spoken-rap verses. 134 BPM, A minor. Bouncy, silly and euphoric. No trap, no autotune, no dubstep drop, no acoustic guitar, no slow ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - rave piano and supersaw stabs]

[Verse 1 - male rap]
Brought him home from the vet at three
Plastic satellite round his head
Hit the doorframe, hit my knee
Hit the cat, the cat hit back

[Pre-Chorus]
Bonk, bonk, here he comes

[Chorus]
Cone of shame
Bouncing off the walls
Cone of shame
Wagging down the hall

[Verse 2 - male rap]
Can't reach the bowl, so I hold it up
Can't fit through the flap at night
Scoops the crumbs up like a plough
Thinks he's got a radar dish

[Pre-Chorus]
Bonk, bonk, mind the lamp

[Chorus]
Cone of shame
Ringing like a bell
Cone of shame
Ten more days of hell

[Bridge - piano breakdown]
Friday morning, cone comes off
He just stands there, feeling light

[Outro - supersaw fade]
Cone of shame
Bonk, bonk, goodnight

tracks.title: Say It Again, Walter
tracks.subject: a woman in her sixties fitted with her first hearing aids, who sits in the car outside the audiologist's office and hears her husband Walter humming along to the radio, something he has apparently done for years
tracks.caption: Philly soul, early 70s sweet soul style. Lush sweeping string section, shimmering vibraphone, Fender Rhodes chords, a warm French horn line, tight bass and four-on-the-floor drum pocket with hi-hat sixteenths. Silky mix with wide strings and soft plate reverb. Female alto lead, warm and glowing, gliding into a sweet head voice, smooth three-part backing harmonies. 96 BPM, E major. Warm, grateful and glowing. No trap drums, no autotune, no rock guitar, no modern EDM, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - strings and vibraphone]

[Verse 1]
Two small beige things behind my ears
The lady said give it a week
I climbed into the car with Walter
And something hummed beside me

[Pre-Chorus]
Low and a little flat
Right along with the radio

[Chorus]
Say it again, Walter
Hum it one more time
Thirty years beside me
And I missed the line

[Verse 2]
He went red right to his collar
Said, I always hum, my dear
I said turn the radio up
I've got some catching up to do

[Pre-Chorus]
Low and a little flat
Sweetest thing on Route 9

[Chorus]
Say it again, Walter
Don't you dare stop now
Thirty years of humming
And I'm hearing it right now

[Bridge - horns and strings]
The turn signal ticking
The kettle when we're home

[Outro - backing vocals]
Say it again, Walter
Hum me all the way home

tracks.title: Half-Mast
tracks.subject: a fourteen-year-old who grew three inches over the summer holidays and turns up on the first day of the new school year in last year's trousers, two inches above his socks, and decides to strut it out
tracks.caption: 70s glam rock stomp revival. Fuzzed-out Les Paul riff with a chugging boogie rhythm, stomping kick and floor tom on every beat, big handclaps, pounding honky-tonk piano, honking baritone saxophone stabs. Loud saturated 70s mix with room-heavy drums. Male lead in a raspy chest voice with a sneer, gang-shout backing vocals on the hooks. 128 BPM, E major. Cocky, loud and laughing. No pop-punk, no autotune, no trap, no synth-pop, no metal screaming.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - stomp, claps and fuzz riff]

[Verse 1]
Went to bed in June a shrimp
Woke up taller than my mum
September came, the trousers didn't
Socks out for everyone

[Chorus]
Half-mast, half-mast
Ankles in the open air
Half-mast, half-mast
Walk like you don't care

[Verse 2]
Mr Price looked at my shins
Said is there a flood today
I said sir, these are a statement
And the whole class clapped away

[Chorus]
Half-mast, half-mast
Stripy socks on show
Half-mast, half-mast
Strut it, there you go

[Bridge - sax solo, then gang shouts]
Mum's got the needle out tonight
Let it down an inch or two

[Chorus]
Half-mast, half-mast
Kids all doing it too
Half-mast, half-mast
Whole school's in on it now

[Outro - stomp and claps]
Half-mast
Take a bow

tracks.caption: Indonesian stoner rock, heavy groove-driven riff rock. Live-room recording, saturated and loud, slight tape warmth. Gritty male mid-low vocal, half-shouted and swaggering, with a wink. 126 BPM, E minor. Mood of a self-mocking riff party. [Intro - fuzz guitar riff, heavy drums]
[Verse 1]
Rapat jam tiga belum selesai
Aku mau kabur pelan-pelan
Kursi kugeser, napas kutahan
Tapi lututku lebih dulu bicara
[Pre-Chorus]
Semua kepala menoleh ke aku
Bos angkat alis, aku duduk lagi

Krek! Lututku bunyi krek!
Umur tiga satu, suara kayak kakek
Krek! Mau kabur pun gagal
Lututku tukang lapor paling andal

Bayi kakakku baru tertidur

Sekarang aku minum susu kalsium
[Outro - organ swell, riff slows down]
Ya sudah, aku duduk saja
Krek
